svg.text: At most 6 rows including buildings; the last unit row becomes misc.
height cap: bottom of the fleet panels
base layout and planet info: covered, never moved
Icons one size smaller to fit under the cap. A unit drag here closes the tray.
Tray panel: frame, background and header font from the GUIDialogs skin
Group header: caption text key, or the category name split into words
Entry: a copy of the mod's own bar slot (b_Create_ art, icon, price, states)
Divider between groups sharing a row: texture from the command atlas
Misc: the last unit row when the groups exceed the budget
Buildings: own bottom row, kept unless nothing can be built
Handle: RevisedBuildTray.xml Handle control, shows +N; Tab or click toggles
